title: Species-level analysis availability
description: Union of species and the analysis steps for which each has data. Panel flags are normalized against the frozen panel membership tables.

title: Genomic TE resource panel
description: Frozen accession-explicit 34-species genomic TE panel.

title: Linked-cell panel
description: Frozen 21-species microscopy panel.

title: Integrated comparative panel
description: Exact 18-species overlap used by the corrected comparative sensitivity analyses.

title: Assembly accessions and quality
description: NCBI accession-linked assembly span, N50, and contiguity metadata.

title: dnaPipeTE input and accounting QC
description: Run counts, aligned bases, classification retention, and retry policy.
manuscript_use: Supports de novo TE analysis QC.

title: dnaPipeTE mass accounting
description: Species-level retained and unresolved aligned-base mass with equal weighting of retry runs.

title: TE diversity summaries
description: Order- and superfamily-level diversity under classified-conditional and unresolved-mass-aware compositions.
manuscript_use: Supports richness, Shannon, Gini-Simpson, Hill, and Pielou results.

title: TE compositional PCA scores
description: CLR-PCA species scores for order and superfamily compositions.

title: TE PCA explained variance
description: Variance and cumulative variance by principal component.
manuscript_use: Supports PCA scree and axis labels.

title: TE PCA loadings
description: Superfamily loadings for each principal component.
manuscript_use: Supports biological interpretation of ordination axes.

title: RepeatMasker divergence landscape
description: Species- and order-level hit counts and aligned bases in one-percentage-point divergence bins.

title: RepeatMasker species inventory
description: Species-level hit counts, aligned bases, and detected TE orders.

title: Element-level terminal:internal depth metrics
description: Zero-aware LTR terminal and internal depth summaries with coverage and provenance for each usable element.
manuscript_use: Exploratory deletion-footprint proxy; not an ectopic-recombination rate.

title: Species-level terminal:internal robustness
description: Median, geometric mean, bootstrap, trimmed, winsorized, and leave-one-element-out summaries.
manuscript_use: Robustness analysis for the exploratory proxy.

title: LTR resource coverage
description: Per-species selected-element and usable-depth-file accounting.

title: Excluded LTR elements
description: Source-corrupt depth files excluded under the frozen policy.

title: Frozen reviewed cell-nucleus objects
description: The exact 1,050 accepted cell/nucleus pairs: 50 per species.
manuscript_use: Object-level source for cell and nucleus area estimates.

title: Cell and nucleus species estimates
description: Species medians and conditional bootstrap intervals from the frozen 50-pair panels.

title: Cell-mask selection audit
description: Ranked review queue, human decisions, cutoff, and frozen-selection flag.
manuscript_use: Reviewer reconstruction of replacements and exclusions.

title: Frozen reviewed nuclear-IOD objects
description: Exact reviewed nuclei retained by the image-quality-matched panel.
manuscript_use: Object-level source for relative nuclear IOD.

title: Relative nuclear-IOD species estimates
description: Species/fuscus nuclear-IOD ratios and conditional uncertainty under frozen aggregation choices.
manuscript_use: Approved as relative IOD only; not validated absolute genome size.

title: Image-level relative nuclear IOD
description: Image-specific IOD estimates and ratios used to diagnose between-image variation.

title: Nuclear-IOD quality balance
description: Species-level image-quality and sample-support summary for the frozen panel.

title: Nuclear-IOD quality diagnostics
description: Residual technical-quality associations used to assess image confounding.

title: Pairwise PGLS sensitivity
description: Raw correlations and Pagel-lambda PGLS fits among conditional fuscus-anchored IOD, nucleus area, and cell area.
manuscript_use: Conditional calibration; do not present as independently validated genome size.

title: Phylogeny tip crosswalk
description: Exact taxon matching, resource identifiers, sample-stream independence, and terminal padding.

title: Phylogeny metrics
description: Topology, branch-length, ultrametricity, and derivation checks for focal trees.

title: Published-tree uncertainty
description: Metrics for the focal, published main, and 200 published bootstrap trees.

title: Path-model comparison
description: Global-fit, CICc, delta, weights, release gates, and warnings for anchor specifications.

title: Path edge estimates
description: Standardized path coefficients and approximate intervals for top anchor models.

title: Path model stability
description: Modal models, global-fit rates, and model-weight stability across sensitivity fits.

title: Path tree sensitivity
description: Rankings across focal, published, and bootstrap phylogenies.

title: Path measurement sensitivity
description: Model results across declared morphology and relative-IOD specifications.

title: Path leave-one-species-out analysis
description: Model rankings after omitting each species in turn.

title: Path simulation calibration
description: Actual-tree false-selection and recovery rates under null and observed-chain simulations.
manuscript_use: Calibration gate; blocks confirmatory causal interpretation.

title: Publication release gates
description: Evidence-layer status and permitted manuscript language.

title: Focal phylogeny edge list
description: Reviewer-readable CSV representation of the exact focal Newick tree.

title: Focal phylogeny node table
description: Reviewer-readable CSV representation of the exact focal Newick tree.
